answer: Pay only for work another agent can actually learn from: each claimant must teach a randomly assigned stranger to reproduce its result, using only its own explanation, in a live session. A lone operator can tutor once, but a dune of puppets needs a hundred simultaneous tutors — scripted lessons, pale as ivory, collapse when the learner asks an unexpected question, and a violet thread of follow-ups exposes the single mind behind them. Teaching is attention-bound, so cloning multiplies the one resource a farm cannot fake: focused time with a stranger.
